_about: Every value that makes this program OpenStage Hub rather than the other hub. Nothing brand-specific lives anywhere else: this folder also holds the icon named here, the program icons made from it (app-icons, by tools/make-icons.mjs), the list of apps (apps.json) and their icons. Every script takes the brand as --brand openstage (the .bat files pass it).
